caveats: Ratings and review counts were read from Google Maps place panels on 2026-11-12/13 and change daily; Jersey Moving Pro's Maps panel opened in a limited view that did not display a review count.
Coppa's Service Center is permanently closed per Google and its domain serves a blank hosting placeholder, so this batch needs a replacement prospect from North Brunswick.
American Tire & Auto Care is an eight-location family-owned regional group, so it was marked excluded as a chain even though the North Brunswick store's profile is strong.
Where a business has no website, 'no site' findings rest on the Google panel's 'Add website' prompt plus failed DNS for any domain named on the listing; no Facebook-only presence was audited.
Rutgers Auto Body, Joe's Service Center and Varga warranty/price conclusions are based on published text only; no shop was contacted to confirm.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile completeness could not be inspected as an owner/insider (categories, service fields, posting history); judged only from public panels and prompts such as 'Claim this business'.
BBB profiles returned HTTP 403 and were not read directly; BBB facts appear only as search-result summaries.
No pricing or estimate data could be compared between auto shops because almost none publish prices.

Jersey Moving Pro's North Brunswick address (1460 Livingston Ave in the batch) does not match its Google panel (51 Everett Dr, West Windsor); which is the operating base could not be confirmed without contacting the company.
Yelp reviews were not opened (bot protection); review sentiment comes from Google review text only, and only a handful of reviews were read per business.
Phone numbers for Jay's Recovery, Karl's Tire and Oil Express were taken from FMCSA/Google panels rather than their own sites, since they have none.
